A.name: A
A.query:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts,
       JSONExtractString(t.labels, 'host.id') AS host,
       max(s.value) AS value
FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4 AS s
INNER JOIN signoz_metrics.time_series_v4 AS t USING (fingerprint)
WHERE s.metric_name = 'loom.queue.starved'
  AND JSONExtractString(t.labels, 'state') = 'ready'
  AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}}
  AND s.unix_milli < {{.end_timestamp_ms}}
GROUP BY ts, host
ORDER BY ts

annotations.description: {{$value}} ready issue(s) on one host (see the alert's host label) have waited past LOOM_QUEUE_STARVATION_SECS (default 6 h). They were held only by capacity (concurrency cap, admission ramp, saturation brake or repo slice) for the whole 15 min window. Run `loom-daemon queue` on that host to see which issues and why. Issue #8856.
